description_en: Binds a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance to an application
kebab_example: aliyun sae bind-nlb --app-id 7171a6ca-d1cd-4928-8642-7d5cfe690000 --nlb-id nlb-7z7jjbzz44d82c9000 --listeners example-string --zone-mappings vsw-sersdf0000_cn-hangzhou-a --address-type Internet --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindNlb

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target application
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NLB instance
parameters.name: nlb_id

parameters.help_en:
The listeners, specified as a JSON-formatted string. Each listener object contains the following fields:

Port: Integer. Required. The listener port. Valid values: 0 to 65535.

TargetPort: Integer. Required. The port on the application instance that receives traffic. Valid values: 0 to 65535.

Protocol: String. Required. The listener protocol. Valid values: `TCP`, `UDP`, and `TCPSSL`.

CertIds: String. Optional. The server certificate IDs. This parameter is required only for `TCPSSL` listeners
parameters.help_zh:
传入要操作的Listeners的JSON数组串，每个Listener的具体结构描述如下：

Port，Integer类型，必选，负载均衡监听端口。取值范围：0~65535。

TargetPort，Integer类型，必选，实例容器监听端口。取值范围：0~65535。

Protocol，String类型，必选，监听协议。取值：TCP、UDP 或 TCPSSL。

CertIds，String类型，可选，服务器证书列表信息。仅对 TCPSSL 监听生效
parameters.name: listeners

parameters.help_en:
The mappings between zones and vSwitches, specified as a JSON-formatted string. You can add up to 10 zones. If the current region supports two or more zones, you must specify at least two zones. Each `ZoneMapping` object contains the following fields:

VSwitchId: String. The ID of the vSwitch in the specified zone. Each zone can have only one vSwitch and one subnet.

ZoneId, String, the zone ID of the Network Load Balancer instance
parameters.help_zh:
可用区及交换机映射列表的JSON字符串。最多支持添加 10 个可用区。若当前地域支持 2 个及以上的可用区，至少需要添加 2 个可用区。一个ZoneMapping结构为：

VSwitchId，String类型，可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区只能使用一台交换机和一个子网。

ZoneId，String类型，网络型负载均衡实例的可用区 ID
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en:
The address type of the NLB instance.

`Internet`: a public IP address.

`Intranet`: a private IP address
parameters.help_zh:
地址类型：
Internet：公网地址。
Intranet：私网地址
parameters.name: address_type

2xx: Successful.

3xx: Redirection.

4xx: Client error.

5xx: Server error

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误
